claim.statement: The publisher's README at tag 1.16.0 states that OpenHands CLI can add, enable and disable MCP servers using HTTP, SSE or stdio transports, extending the tools available to the agent.

values: one or more enabled MCP servers

limitations: This records publisher-described extensibility, not the behavior or trustworthiness of any MCP server.
The authority, credentials, network destinations and side effects of enabled MCP tools are configuration-specific.
unknowns: Which MCP servers, transports, headers, environment variables and credentials a particular session exposes are unknown.
Whether confirmation coverage differs among built-in and MCP-provided tools was not tested.
